Coerce an assimilative causal inference result to a data frame

Source: R/aci-methods.R
as.data.frame.aci.Rd

Flattens the posterior trajectories and the causal-information metric into one tidy row per time step, for plotting, export or joining to other series.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'aci'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

An aci object, as returned by aci().

row.names

Passed to data.frame().

optional

Passed to data.frame().

...

Ignored, for compatibility with as.data.frame().

Value

A data frame with one row per time step and the columns t, x, filter_mean, filter_cov, smoother_mean, smoother_cov and aci.

See also

aci(), summary.aci()

Examples

model <- aci_dyad_model()
fit <- aci(aci_simulate(model, n = 2000, seed = 1)$x, model)
head(as.data.frame(fit))
#>       t         x filter_mean filter_cov smoother_mean smoother_cov        aci
